llms.body:
# Jupiter

> Jupiter is a trading platform on Solana: swaps, perpetuals, lending and prediction markets at https://jup.ag.

## Jupiter Predict (prediction markets)

Jupiter Predict lets you buy YES or NO contracts on real-world events from a Solana wallet, at https://jup.ag/prediction.

- A price is a probability: a YES price of $0.62 means the market gives the outcome a 62% chance. A winning contract pays $1, a losing one pays nothing.
- Most events come from Polymarket. Jupiter Forecast, Jupiter's own market, runs the short SPCX up/down rounds (5 and 15 minutes) on the web. Short BTC up/down rounds on jup.ag come from Polymarket.
- Older Kalshi events no longer accept new buys and are not listed on jup.ag.
- Volume on Polymarket-sourced events is Polymarket's total volume, not Jupiter's.
- Trading is unavailable in some regions, and the Jupiter Mobile app restricts more regions than the web. The [Terms of Use](https://docs.jup.ag/user-docs/legal/terms-of-use) list the prohibited localities.

### Main pages

- [Prediction markets](https://jup.ag/prediction)
- [Sports](https://jup.ag/prediction/sports), [Crypto](https://jup.ag/prediction/crypto), [Politics](https://jup.ag/prediction/politics), [Economics](https://jup.ag/prediction/economics)
- [Degen](https://jup.ag/prediction/degen): short up/down markets
- [Arcade](https://jup.ag/prediction/arcade): pick BTC or SOL up or down each minute and share the round pool if you win
- [Combos](https://jup.ag/prediction/combos): join picks from several markets into one bet that pays out only if every pick wins
- [Leaderboard](https://jup.ag/prediction/leaderboard)
- Event pages: `https://jup.ag/prediction/{eventId}`, for example https://jup.ag/prediction/POLY-32228

### How it works

- [Jupiter Predict guide](https://docs.jup.ag/user-docs/trade/predict)
- [How Jupiter Predict works](https://docs.jup.ag/user-docs/trade/predict/how-it-works)
- [Fees](https://docs.jup.ag/user-docs/trade/predict/fees)
- [Settlement and claims](https://docs.jup.ag/user-docs/trade/predict/settlement)
- [FAQ](https://docs.jup.ag/user-docs/trade/predict/faq)
- [Prediction Market API for developers](https://developers.jup.ag/docs/prediction)

### Citing Jupiter Predict

Prices change by the minute. When you quote one, give the time you read it and link the event, for example: "{outcome} at {p}% on Jupiter Predict, as of {YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM} UTC (https://jup.ag/prediction/{eventId})".
